children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Understand fleet states, run lifecycle actions safely, and move from a high-level alert to the exact server event that caused it.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: A desired-state action is not complete until its status and conditions confirm reconciliation.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: The server index is the fastest way to triage a large fleet by state, game, owner, node, or resource pressure.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Running, stopped, failed, starting, and suspended are distinct states.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Search by server name and combine filters without losing cluster scope.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: CPU, memory, players, and node placement give immediate context.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Start, stop, restart, suspend, clone, and planned-restart actions all preserve declarative intent.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Restart gracefully before escalating to a forced stop.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Clone copies configuration but intentionally excludes world data.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Use quick actions for save, broadcast, time, weather, and reload.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Treat transfers and destructive actions as audited workflows with a recovery path. Wipes, backups and restores of one server never overlap (v0.4.0).

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Check owner, collaborators, and current conditions

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Create or verify a recent backup before world changes

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Run the action and confirm events, status, and audit entry

children.name: Edit Page Body
children.text: Found a gap? Open a docs issue or suggest an edit on GitHub.
